newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares add on, seen drifting.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares add on, seen drifting.

text.p: 1315 GMT - Austrian shares end with moderate gains on Monday with market steeped in wait-and-see mood ahead of the expiry of futures and options on Friday and the EU summit in Amsterday.
ATX index seen hemmed into its claustrophobic trading range of late.
* ATX index up 0.44 percent at 1,307.97 points.
* 15 ATX shares higher, five lower, one unchanged.
* Top ATX gainer Mayr-Melnhof, up 9.9 schillings at 630.
* Leading ATX decliner Wolford, down 24 schillings at 1,215.
* June ATX future up 7.5 points at 1,312.6. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
